heading: Today
text: Morning clouds, patches of fog, and a few breaks of sun.  A spotty shower, mainly this morning in NH.  Increasing periods of afternoon sun, especially in the St. Lawrence and southern valleys.  Cool.  Highs in the upper 50s to low 60s, mid 60s where it’s sunnier.  Winds light, mainly north less than 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Gradual clearing.  Areas of dense fog and low clouds forming.  Lows in the 40s to low 50s.  Winds light and variable.

heading: Wednesday
text: Areas of low clouds and dense valley fog burning off to a mix of clouds and sunshine.  Seasonably warm.  Highs in the upper 60s to low 70s.  Winds light and variable.
